title: The Tenth Finding

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: Nine strokes and ten strokes are both strokes on a board. The board keeps no tally, and the hand that counted goes home cold.
epigraph.attribution: A Low Kiln saying, told over the charcoal beneath a loaf shelf

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and eighty-four to three hundred and eighty-six days, six months and two hundred and four to two hundred and six days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. As in chapters 25 through 110 the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone: no present-tense break, no tagged memory, no departure from the boy's eyes, and the carried fire's payer stays unnamed. Each morning the register takes the body in its old order — one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool; the empty place beside it holding the fold of wool Sella put there on the fifteenth, found where put on nine mornings and nine goings of the light and now found a tenth, an eleventh and a twelfth time with no second fold, third crust or name; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — while the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning. The chapter lives the year's last working week: the kiln banked behind its wall, the river under its winter skin, the yard going around its seven walked-around places with the returning-line place widest and once and not twice, the hearth grammar at both ends, the twice-mended pot kept apart from restoration, the dressed grain covered and unfigured, the charcoal unread and the widow's mark untouched. The keeping at the fold passes from nine findings to ten: still a finding, still not a placing, a habit wanting a hand that placed twice and a way a third and both wanting a payer where none stands. Eleven arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure with no signature and no doctrine out of eleven; the fourth ownerless direction of Stone 23 stands on its own place beside the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17 and Ash 23 directions and does not repeat; Stone 30's last reading gathers beyond the close and is not brought into a day that has not earned it.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Tenth Finding
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{384}{Stone 25, Fifthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours opening the last working week of the year under the Vail kiln-house roof, with the hand laid flat on answer 342 and the count exact at 383 carried out of Chapter 110. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects only (the salt-stiff coat with its left-shoulder crease on the peg behind the door, the hollow wheel-seat, the clean dark line at the Vail corner with its finer grey called the thaw thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash, the twice-mended pot's hairline between old-brass staple and tighter wire, the unforged collector sentence at the kindling, the uncalled tile debt). No Ilva, Tarn, Jorra, Hessa, Berr, collector, runner, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice — the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17, Ash 23 and Stone 23 directions stand where put and do not repeat and buy no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). No recap: the fourth direction bought no teaching under this roof and eleven arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure without a doctrine. **The chapter's one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T097/T060/T086):** the wool is found folded once in the crust's empty place a TENTH time, unchanged by the night, with no second fold, third crust, name, gift, payment or payer; ten findings from a hand that only read add no tenth placing, a second placing would make a habit and a third a way and both want a payer where none stands. The boy files the tenth beside the crust's gap, the shelf's two gaps, the gone pan's round ring and the field's empty place, holds it as finding and not placing, and does not let ten likenesses stand up and call themselves an account, for an account wants a hand to lay them together and no such hand stands. Dramatic purpose: the count of findings reaches double figures for the first time and still buys nothing. The surgeon takes the body in its old order — leathery brown-edged crust gone harder and browner in the dry cold with its corner a hair off the wool; cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; pink returning is surface still cold and not the core, a basket set level out of the draught is the careful rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for; the afterdrop waits past a warming nobody here will perform — while the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it* where another woman would say I, counts a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening and figures neither gap; her finger lies along the top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, her lips move along a two-gapped row unfigured, she glances once at the clay jar under lead glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing with the little-door burn closing on air, and the widow's mark hangs untouched because a morning is not an opening and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule (T058/T079/T100). Both proverbs go to the pot and the fire and never to a person, the crack left showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire, repair kept apart from restoration; the dressed grain is turned under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child and no figure and no handful (T077); the twice-mended pot's rim is set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and the interval is bought at nothing and is not a gift. She carries him down the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, the instruction going to the wool, the river wind and the fire she will bank against their coming back and never to the basket, and sets him level and out of the draught. The yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest around the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, once and not twice, because a going-around twice would make a figure of once and a figure wants a payer standing under it (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). The clean dark line keeps its finer grey called the thaw unswept with the sour tang of Ash; the broken birth-slates beneath the lowest rack are entered by nobody; the round ring at the rack end keeps no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word; the gone white frost off the well's north lip, the skin across the trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone stay three coverings entered nowhere with a finger between every pair, and the river's winter skin stays on its own place beside water over water, found where put and not spent (T083/T085). In the small hours the file comes out on the towel at the head of the bed as instruments come out when a case is done, with every gap left gap; the six hearings stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's flat knock outside them, the heard bell of the Long Night stays in its square beside the told, four, four and a gap, and the four rooms with the same gap stay held apart with a finger between every pair (T061/T082, T081). He files answer **three hundred and forty-three**: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the eleven readings, the bell's gap, the flat knock, the child's grey fingertips, the mother's cup, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the held breath, the two bites of iron, the river's skin, the widow's mark, the fourth direction nor the keeping at the fold. The count stands at **384 exact**, six months and two hundred and four days told by nobody who would have known what a number counted, the carried fire's fifth unpaid the same number and Garl's name unspoken the same number (T071/T072, T088). Five mornings stand between this day and Stone 30's last reading and are not brought into it. No sixth hearing, tenth hand, tenth stopping, eighth opening, twelfth arithmetic, witness, reader, payment, name for the green or the shape, third crust or ending. Forward, not closed.

scenes.title: Six Counted, the Seventh Held
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Stone 25 through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day with answer 344. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge and damper; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: a Cold Acre hare-carrier shifting a hare across his shoulders, a cracked-jar man in a rope sling, a woman with a basket of kindling, two fence-menders arguing the thaw. No Ilva, Hessa, Berr, collector, green-mouthed woman or foundling; no market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice — the fourth direction of Stone 23 stands where put and does not repeat (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). Dramatic purpose: the loan stays uncalled at the very end of a seventh year, and the equality under the roof holds without a word. Out in the Clay Yard the afternoon stands in the dry cold and the yard goes around its seven places once and not twice. To the hare-carrier who answers the price of ice with the weather, the cracked-jar man sent to a pot that says nothing, the kindling woman who asks what the seventh year will want and the two fence-menders who want the thaw early and late, Tarn says *Yes, house* to each and keeps the late because it puts off the paying, agreeing so thoroughly that no argument finds a foot (T036/T076). At the kindling six pieces lie in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, with no name on the man who turned back at the frozen ford and no figure on the debt. The small knife lies at the very edge of its sill; his hand passes over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, and the coming away is the whole of the checking. He tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, and cuts nothing, counts nothing, spends nothing. The Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting are found where put and not made again, beside the five held objects and the pot-crack resting with a finger between every pair, neither a sixth held object nor a tenth stopping; he brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year now at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled, his chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into the knuckle creases the colour of the clean dark line, the pale clip-ring at his left wrist catching what little light there is, his stroke going over the shallow bright patch of the flagstones without the half-check. A term ending is not a payment, a forgiveness or a freedom, and the fear that a man with no house will be entered again for vagrancy stays his, kept without a figure (T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door off the wheel-shed with the day's meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and white in a fist-crease where a hand had opened, and it is not the bone-coloured slip of the wheel; three or more men unnamed have gone low into the back room before first grey and he gives the house no name for them and no word that the room is cold. He keeps his dusty forearms and clean ones on one tray and parts them as clot from vessel, asking neither which slate had been broken nor whether it was a birth-slate while the broken ones under the lowest rack stay entered by nobody; he speaks to the wheel before any person — *It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady* — and tells a pot going past *You'll do* in a voice with no welcome in it and no unkindness either, knowing the full note it will give three turns ahead, with air under it and a want in it, and withholding that knowing from any master come up from High Kiln who would call it early and sing a pot before its time (a knowing on a tray of its own beside the hearings and never among them). When Sella has not finished telling him the fire is low his bent finger goes into the cold iron of the damper ahead of her sentence, takes the cold out of the fingertip, moves the tongue a hair's breadth and is left standing so that the end of her instruction arrives at the pot and the household straightens around the waiting as cloth straightens when a weight is lifted — one piece of iron with two bites, the holding and the taking, and no Grathic word covering both mercies — and the finger comes out without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time (T062/T035/T031). *He's not Vail* stays sealed as a lid nobody has tried to lift in three years; the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn, gathering interest against the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness, the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17, Ash 23 and Stone 23 directions — all standing where put, none repeating, none buying a lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). At the going of the light Sella carries him up the nineteen steps under the roof and never into the Debt Loft, sets him at the low angle of the loaf shelf, says nothing of where they have been, puts the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and adds no second fold to the empty place; the thread stays frozen and unwiped and the wool is found where put again and not made again. Under the roof she goes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it* where another woman would say I, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure and no handful, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, and sets the rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). Under the floor the carried fire gives four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer without a name for three hundred and eighty-four days; nobody lifts the floor to supply the pull and nobody names the payer (T088). In the small hours the file comes out on the towel with every gap left gap; he files answer **three hundred and forty-four**, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment, laid across neither the eleven readings, the bell's gap, the flat knock, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the held breath, the two bites of iron, the river's skin, the widow's mark, the fourth direction nor the keeping at the fold. The count stands at **384 exact**, six months and two hundred and four days told by nobody, the fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number. Stone 25 is kept without a boundary drawn, the month holding both its names, older women by weather and slatemen by Account-days, neither set right nor left in so many words. Nothing from the yard, the kindling, the damper or the fourth direction crosses under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Forward, not closed.

scenes.title: The Eleventh Finding
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{385}{Stone 26, Sixthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours opening the middle day of the last working week, hand laid flat on answer 344 and count exact at 384 carried in, moving into the morning. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Ilva once at the yard well; Garl Vail in objects. New day, new date and no recap: eleven arithmetics behind one unsigned figure bought no teaching here and the tenth finding of yesterday was a finding and not a habit. Dramatic purpose: the count in wood stays a count in wood, and the boy refuses to turn a ninth hand's record into a figure. The surgeon takes the body in its old order — leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool; cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; a face composed by cold is not composure and pink returning is the surface still cold and not the core; the afterdrop waits past a warming nobody here will perform — while the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). **T097/T060/T086 advanced and NOT paid:** the wool is found folded once in the crust's empty place an ELEVENTH time, unchanged by the night; eleven findings from a hand that only read add no eleventh placing, a second placing would make a habit and a third a way and both want a payer where none stands. He files it beside the crust's gap, the shelf's two gaps, the gone pan's round ring and the field's empty place, not a joining of rooms, not a gift, payment, payer, sixth held object, habit, way, sign, hearing, mending, cause or rule, gathering interest toward the far-off finger that will one day lay shelf and fold together and call the joining an account — that hand is not his and has not come. Sella keeps the morning grammar: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, *The house will keep it* where another woman would say I, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the loaf shelf with the charcoal unread, lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the widow's mark untouched because a morning is not an opening and no eighth is made due (T058/T079/T100). She carries him down the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire she will bank against their coming back and never to the basket, level and out of the draught; the yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest around the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, once and not twice (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). At the yard well Ilva draws with the pail against her knee, the rope stiff in the Stone cold giving its small dry rasp, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and the finer grey dust of the racks worked into the seam of one thumb which she does not scrub out; to the woman waiting her turn who asks what Stone's firings have taken, her hand goes toward her sleeve and stays, the short strip of notched birch bark lying in the fold where it always lies, pale where a thumb has rubbed the notches and dark in the uncut grain between, and it is not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, to the charcoal beneath the loaf shelf, to the cord, the knot-string or any saying that has arrived nowhere, and no figure comes off the wood. Her eyes go to the asker and her mouth opens after both with a half-beat between the looking and the word; she answers the question put and not the one behind it: *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account.* Then she puts the flat of her hand once more on the sleeve and goes back to the pail, and nobody turns twice. **T080 advanced and NOT paid:** her order of reaching is filed by the boy as anatomy — hand to the record before eyes to the person, eyes before mouth, the half-beat in the gap where a lesser observer would put an intention — her NINTH record-first hand on a place of its own with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth; no tenth hand is filed, no reader is made of her keeping, no figure comes off the wood, and she is expressly not the speaker of any ownerless voice (the Frost 14 well-saying stays at one saying and four shapings with no fifth, advanced and not paid). She does not look into the basket and has no notion she has been read. The river's winter skin is found where put on the first day of the month and found again this morning and not made again, on its own place beside water over water, not a hearing, not spent (T083/T085). In the small hours the file comes out on the towel with every gap left gap; six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's flat knock outside them, the heard bell stays in its square beside the told, four, four and a gap, and the four rooms with the same gap stay held apart (T061/T082, T081). He files answer **three hundred and forty-five**, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment, laid across neither the eleven readings, the bell's gap, the flat knock, the child's grey fingertips, the mother's cup, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the held breath, the two bites of iron, the river's skin, the widow's mark, the fourth direction nor the keeping at the fold. The count stands at **385 exact**, six months and two hundred and five days told by nobody, the carried fire's fifth unpaid the same number and Garl's name unspoken the same number (T071/T072, T088). No sixth hearing, tenth hand, tenth stopping, eighth opening, twelfth arithmetic, reader, witness, payment, fifth shaping, name for the green or the shape, third crust or ending. Forward, not closed.

Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it* where another woman would say I, stands a moment on intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening and figures neither gap, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar standing cold under lead glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing with the little-door burn closing on air, and leaves the widow's mark untouched, for a morning is not an opening and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule and no eighth is made due (T058/T079/T100). Both proverbs go to the pot and the fire and never to a person, repair kept apart from restoration, the crack left showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire; the dressed grain is turned under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child and no figure and no handful (T077); the pot's rim is set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and the interval is bought at nothing and is not a gift. She carries him down the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire she will bank against their coming back and never to the basket, and the yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest around the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, once and not twice (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried); the clean dark line and its finer grey called the thaw stay unswept with the sour tang of Ash, the broken birth-slates under the lowest rack are entered by nobody, the round ring at the rack end keeps no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word, the three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair, and the river keeps its winter skin on its own place beside water over water, found where put and not made again (T083/T085). In the small hours the file comes out on the towel with every gap left gap; the five held objects stand with the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath and the holding in the damper beside them, each on a place of its own with a finger between every pair, and the keeping at the fold stands beside them and is expressly not a tenth held object; six hearings stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's flat knock outside, the heard bell stays in its square beside the told, four, four and a gap, and the four rooms with the same gap stay held apart (T061/T082, T081). Eleven arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure — three of Frost, first, second and third of Bone, first, second and third of Ash, Stone's first and Stone's second — the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of eleven; their eleven true subtractions ride locked in Berr Clay's box up the clay road toward High Kiln, the key gone up in a coat pocket that does not come back down and the boy having no key (T015/T041/T047 held). He files answer **three hundred and forty-seven**, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the eleven readings, the bell's gap, the flat knock, the child's grey fingertips, the mother's cup, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the held breath, the two bites of iron, the river's skin, the widow's mark, the fourth direction nor the keeping at the fold. The count stands at **386 exact**, six months and two hundred and six days told by nobody who would have known what a number counted, the carried fire's fifth unpaid the same number and Garl's name unspoken the same number (T071/T072, T088). Three mornings stand between this day and Stone 30's last reading and are not brought into it; the Five stand beyond that. Forward, not closed.

scenes.title: The Count Goes On
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Stone 27, the yard going around its places, the kindling and the damper checked, the carry home at the going of the light, the hearth grammar renewed, and the small hours at the very end of the day with the file out on the towel and answer 348. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail in the afternoon; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: a Cold Acre hare-carrier, a cracked-jar man in a rope sling, a woman with a basket of kindling, two fence-menders. No Ilva, Hessa, Berr, collector, green-mouthed woman or foundling; no market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice — the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17, Ash 23 and Stone 23 directions stand where put, do not repeat and buy no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). Dramatic purpose: check every object and leave every gap a gap, let the eleven readings, the twelve findings and the four directions gather interest without being paid, and close on forward motion toward the year's last reading. Sella carries him down the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire she will bank against their coming back and never to the basket, level and out of the draught; the yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest around the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, once and not twice, because a going-around twice would make a figure of once and a figure wants a payer standing under it (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). The clean dark line at the Vail corner and its finer grey called the thaw stay unswept with the faint sour tang of Ash; the broken birth-slates under the lowest rack are entered by nobody; the round ring where the shallow pan once stood keeps no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word; the gone white frost off the well's north lip, the skin drawn edge to edge across the trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone set a little out of the path of feet stay three coverings entered nowhere with a finger between every pair; out on the worked strips the field keeps its empty place and does not fill it; and the river keeps its winter skin on its own place beside water over water, found where put on the first day of the month and found again this afternoon and not made again, not spent on the week's work or on the going of the light and not made to buy a lesson under any roof (T083/T085). At the kindling the account stands in its old exactness: six pieces in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, no name on the man who turned back at the frozen ford and no figure on the debt. Tarn passes his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, cuts nothing, counts nothing, spends nothing; the Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting are found where put and not made again, not a sixth held object, not a tenth stopping; he brings the ear-sentence up to the word that would call the loan and stops there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year now at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled, and he does not look along the clay road (T036/T076/T006). Chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into the knuckle creases, pale clip-ring at the left wrist, stroke over the bright flagstones without the half-check; a term ending is not a payment, a forgiveness or a freedom, and the fear of being entered again for vagrancy stays his. Jorra comes through the finger's-width door off the wheel-shed with meal-fine grey slate dust white in a fist-crease, not the bone-coloured slip of the wheel; three or more men unnamed have gone low into the back room before first grey and he gives the house no name for them and no word that the room is cold. Dusty forearms and clean ones are kept on one tray and parted as clot from vessel; he speaks to the wheel before any person — *It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady* — tells a pot *You'll do* with no welcome and no unkindness, knows the full note three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withholds it from any High Kiln master who would call it early; when Sella has not finished telling him the fire is low his bent finger goes into the cold iron of the damper ahead of her sentence, takes the cold out of the fingertip, moves the tongue a hair's breadth and is left standing so that the end of her instruction arrives at the pot and the household straightens around the waiting — one piece of iron with two bites, the holding and the taking, with no Grathic word covering both mercies — then comes out without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time (T062/T035/T031). *He's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn, gathering interest against the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness, the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17, Ash 23 and Stone 23 directions — all standing where put, none repeating, none buying a lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). At the going of the light Sella carries him up the nineteen steps under the roof and never into the Debt Loft, sets him at the low angle of the loaf shelf, says nothing of where they have been, puts the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and adds no second fold to the empty place; the thread stays frozen and unwiped and the wool is found where put a twelfth time and is not made again. Under the roof she goes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it* where another woman would say I, stands a moment on a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening and figures neither gap, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row and gives neither gap a number, glances once at the clay jar under lead glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing with the little-door burn closing on air, and leaves the widow's mark untouched, for a going of the light and a bed are no openings and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule (T058/T079/T100). The twice-mended pot stands on the pot board with the hairline of the original break showing between the old-brass staple and the tighter wire; she lifts it thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack before the weight comes on the handle and gives both proverbs to the pot and the fire and never to a person, repair kept apart from restoration; she turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure and no handful and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T077). Inside the wool his hand goes toward the rim and stops where the half-beat stopped it, and that interval is bought at nothing and is not a gift. Under the floor the carried fire gives four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer without a name for three hundred and eighty-six days; nobody lifts the floor to supply the pull and nobody names the payer (T088). In the small hours the towel comes out at the head of the bed as instruments come out when a case is done and before the next is called, with every gap left gap. Twelve honest findings stand at the fold and are not a placing; the five held objects stand with the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath and the holding in the damper beside them, each on a place of its own with a finger between every pair, and the keeping is expressly not a tenth held object; nine record-first hands keep no tenth and nine stoppings keep no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; the burned-slate word stands at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness and expressly no sixth, the well-saying at four shapings with no fifth, and the Frost 14 saying no fifth shaping; the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17, Ash 23 and Stone 23 directions stand with a finger between every pair and none is joined to Jorra's promise, the keeping or the eleven readings; the finding that eleven are not one account sits on a place of its own with a finger between it and every other kept thing; six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among, the sixth the small flat knock out of Dessa Silt as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go and never among the sources, the seventh place empty and not dug for, and the Drawing's flat knock outside them on its own place; the heard bell of the Long Night stays in its square beside the told, four, four and a gap, and is not folded into the counts; the four rooms with the same gap stay held apart with a finger between every pair, four likenesses and not one account, an account wanting a hand to lay them together and a payer under all four and no such hand standing and no such payer. No sixth hearing, seventh opening, sixth held object, sixth telling, third shut-room telling, sixth asking, fifth shaping, tenth hand, tenth stopping or twelfth arithmetic is supplied to make a row come out even, for a finding filled to make a row come out even is a finding forged. Eleven arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of eleven, their eleven true subtractions locked in Berr Clay's box up the clay road, the key gone up in a coat pocket that does not come back down and the boy having no key (T015/T041/T047 held). The surgeon takes his small clean satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found, and it cost him nothing, which is how he knows it is not peace; under it, louder, the infant wants the crust lifted two inches, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, and gets none of the three, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the quarrel the work and no verdict in it. Through the finger's-width door the river keeps its note of water over water under its winter skin, nearer at the going of the water than at its coming, muffled as a voice is muffled by a shut door; the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward it, does not reach, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the skin, lets it go as the note ended and comes straight down and lays itself flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. The note had done before the hand came down, so the letting-go was neither early nor stayed, and the hand did not stay. He files it as answer **three hundred and forty-eight**: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the eleven readings, the bell's gap, the flat knock, the child's grey fingertips, the mother's cup, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the held breath, the two bites of iron, the river's skin, the widow's mark, the fourth direction nor the keeping at the fold. The surgeon's exactness is not comfort. \place{Stone} keeps its twenty-fifth, twenty-sixth and twenty-seventh days without a boundary drawn, the deep-winter month holding both its names, older women by weather and slatemen by Account-days, neither set right nor left in so many words. The count stands at **three hundred and eighty-six exact**, six months and two hundred and six days told by nobody who would have known what a number counted, the carried fire's fifth unpaid the same number and Garl's name unspoken the same number (T071/T072, T088). Twelve findings are twelve findings and not a rule, eleven arithmetics are eleven and not one account, and four directions are four and not a witness. The year's last working week runs out with nothing in it standing up and calling itself an account. Stone 28, 29 and 30 stand ahead, and Stone 30's last reading and twelfth arithmetic gathers three mornings beyond the close, unbrought; the Five stand beyond that. The hand lies flat on the fold with the crust's corner standing a hair off the wool and the count goes on under the roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath. Forward, not closed.
